name: Neebota: Zeebo's Awakening
detailed_description:
An open world party-based RPG set in an original fantasy world called Neebota, where Zeebo and his friends hunt for portals from our earth, overcome themselves in their dreams, and in doing so, uncover secret powers, ancient lore of their world and a vast conspiracy across space and time. With music by legendary David Wise!

THE STORY

Wet with sweat, Zeebo wakes up after what seems to have been the final dream in a long streak of torturous nightmares where his body painfully morphs. With his best friends at his bedside, he realizes his latest nightmare contained the main the clue to his suffering. And it's not just his parents' death! As he explains his insights to his friends, they all come to the same conclusion: it's time to take action.

With his friends Laurencia, Rashkadim, Bervie and his beloved pet Hekke, Zeebo embarks on a grand adventure to get to the bottom of what's causing disturbances not just in his sleep, but in his world Neebota. A quest that takes them through intrigue in their own backyard, back into Zeebo's dreams, the dark, deeply hidden underbelly of Neebota, as well as to our very own earth — but not quite as we know it.

Neebota: Zeebo's Awakening is a party-based RPG with a blend of action and deep strategy. Rich in lore, it's set in an entirely original fantasy world called Neebota. The game takes inspiration from many old school classics like Chrono Trigger, Secret of Mana and the Zelda series, but also modern PC RPGs, especially from open world ones like the Elder Scrolls series or Dragon Age.

THE WORLD OF NEEBOTA

Neebota is inhabited by beings who undergo many of the same emotions and experiences we humans do: hope, joy, loss, dreams, curiosity, and overcoming the self. Zeebo and his friends are fascinated by portals to our very own earth that have started to appear on Neebota. There are clues that this is not the first time in Neebota's history that these portals have started showing up. What's more, Zeebo's involvement may not be entirely coincidental...

FEATURES

  • A unique blend of JRPG and PC RPG elements

  • Explore Zeebo's bizarre nightmare as well as his waking world with his friends

  • Hybrid class & skill use system to develop your party members

  • Bizarre and fantastical enemies, catacombs, dungeons and areas to conquer and explore

  • A new and entirely original fantasy world, rich with lore

  • Deep story with lots of dialogue, fully voiced.

  • Hauntingly beautiful soundtrack by industry legend David Wise

  • Solo or Multiplayer Coop locally, LAN or online

Want to know more?

Neebota is a whole new and original world developed by Frying Jelly that debuts in 99 Fails. Learn more about it at Neebota [dot] com
